summary: Strong script with excellent bash hygiene (set -euo pipefail, quoted vars, proper error handling). Workflow follows most conventions (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, defensive jq install). Issues: (1) Workflow hardcodes fixtures/ manifest path, reducing flexibility—manifest detection should be parameterizable or in the script itself; (2) || true suppresses failures, relying on fragile output parsing instead of exit codes; (3) No upfront validation that config files (allow-list, deny-list, licenses.db) exist. Script's separation of concerns and sourcing guard are excellent, but workflow duplicates manifest detection logic (lines 30–37) that the script already handles.
